name: starterkit-codesign-quickstart-claude-agent-sdk-js-node
description: A CoDesign SDK starter kit: a design agent on the Claude Agent SDK turns a brief into a PNG and an editable design, with the executor in Docker on your machine.

scripts.executor: docker rm -f codesign-executor-claude-agent-sdk >/dev/null 2>&1; docker run -d --name codesign-executor-claude-agent-sdk --restart always -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 --env-file .env --tmpfs /var/lib/codesign-executor:uid=1000 imgly/codesign-executor:1.84.0
